uiWiringGaps.gap: Current AvaloniaDirectPrintCapability is Deferred and ExportXps is null in the Backstage callback set; integration must inject CupsPrintService and later dialog selection.
The existing preview button chooses Print versus Create PDF from BackstageDirectPrintCapability; the integration pass must provide a real direct-print callback and cancellation/error messaging.
The view already accepts DirectPrintCapability and ExportXps callbacks; integration must supply the new adapter contracts without changing this owned shell UI file.
Export XPS rows appear only when an ExportXps callback is supplied; the integration pass decides whether the truthful Avalonia capability is exposed after a font-resource provider exists.
No gap to wire in this slice: WPF PrintDialog and native XPS behavior remain intact and outside the edit boundary.

xpsLimitation: The current Avalonia PdfContentDocument/PdfDrawOp model exposes text strings and positioned draw ops, but no embedded XPS font bytes, font URI, glyph indices, subsetting metadata, or equivalent glyph-outline renderer. A normal text document therefore cannot be truthfully emitted as selectable XPS until that exact dependency is supplied.
